note: Both sets contain OCR errors, specifically truncating the unit to 'watt/ra' in one claim and omitting the subscript 'K' in the quotes for the angle value ($	heta_K$). Set A is better because it uses a vague but factually acceptable attribute ('theta') for $	heta_K$, whereas Set B incorrectly labels $	heta_K$ as the 'best-fit line intercept' (the intercept is actually the sensitivity value at $	heta=0$). Both sets include redundant claims.
